LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.0.label: Keep the Soul
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.0.description: Retains the chosen Soul evolution. Refinement: kill healing and every-third-hit Soul damage. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50; healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.1.label: Gather Thought
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.1.description: Two ordinary hits on the same enemy within 4 seconds leave focus for 4 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Switching victims or a 4-second gap resets progress; abilities and bonus damage do not count. Refinement: mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.2.label: Aftertone
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.2.description: An actual Soul ability hit leaves an aftertone for 4 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Later pulses and hits during recovery neither renew nor move it. Other abilities, ordinary hits and bonus damage do not trigger it. Refinement: mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.3.label: Soul Rend
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.3.description: A Soul ability hit spends the victim’s focus for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. Later pulses add nothing without fresh focus. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.4.label: Bind Thought
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.4.description: An ordinary hit spends existing focus to leave a fixed anchor at the impact cell for 4 seconds. A later actual Soul ability hit within 2 cells grants the author a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per anchor. No new anchor can be placed while one is pending or for 3 seconds after its shield grant. The anchor does not follow its victim. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.5.label: Draw the Soul
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.5.description: An ordinary hit spends the victim’s aftertone to deal 50 extra damage to the nearest other enemy within 4 cells. With no second enemy, retain the mark without extending its expiry. Abilities and bonus damage cannot trigger it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.6.label: Soul Offering
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.6.description: An ordinary hit spends the victim’s aftertone to mend up to 20 points of non-permanent injury on the most injured other colonist within 4 cells of the author. Scars are not healed. With no eligible patient, retain the mark without extending its expiry. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.7.label: Fractured Echo
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.7.description: Actual Soul Rend damage records its impact cell for 4 seconds. An ordinary hit on a different enemy releases one pulse there, dealing 50 damage each to at most 2 enemies within 2 cells, excluding the new trigger victim. An empty area retains the opportunity without extending it. The cell does not follow its original victim. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.8.label: Return to the Circle
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.8.description: After the bound shield first absorbs enemy damage, walk at least one cell and ordinarily hit that attacker within 1 cell of the fixed anchor, within 4 seconds, to mend up to 20 points of non-permanent injury. Once per shield. Teleporting cancels it. Scars are excluded; having no eligible wound retains the opportunity without extending it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.9.label: Joined Voices
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.9.description: Actual Draw the Soul damage marks its victim for 4 seconds. The first other colonist to land an ordinary hit on it receives a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds. The target cannot reset while awaiting the relay or for 3 seconds after the shield grant. The author, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.10.label: Return Passage
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.10.descriptio: After Soul Offering actually heals, remember its patient for 4 seconds. A Soul ability hit on a different enemy from the healing trigger grants that original patient a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, if within 4 cells, once. Later pulses do not refill it; the passage cannot reset for 3 seconds after its shield grant. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.11.label: Scattered Souls
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.11.descriptio: Within 3 seconds after the pulse first deals actual damage, a Soul ability hit on a different enemy from its first victim sends bolts for 25 damage each to at most 2 other enemies within 3 cells of the new target, once per pulse. No secondary target retains the opportunity without extending it. Bolts cannot produce more bolts. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.12.label: Shelter in the Echo
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.12.descriptio: Within 3 seconds after the pulse first deals actual damage, walk at least one cell, reach within 1 cell of its fixed impact area and ordinarily hit an enemy for a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds, once per pulse. Teleporting cancels it; later hits neither refill nor extend the shield. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.13.label: Leave the Circle
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.13.descriptio: Within 3 seconds after Return to the Circle actually heals, walk at least one more cell, leave the anchor’s 1-cell area and ordinarily hit a different enemy for 50 extra damage, once. Standing still, teleporting, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.14.label: Rest for the Soul
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.14.descriptio: Within 3 seconds after Return to the Circle actually heals, ordinarily hit a different enemy to mend up to 20 points on the most non-permanently injured other colonist within 4 cells, once. Scars are excluded. With no patient, retain the opportunity without extending it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.15.label: Answer the Call
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.15.descriptio: Within 3 seconds after the partner’s Joined Voices shield first absorbs enemy damage, the author’s Soul ability hit on that attacker deals 50 extra soul damage, once per shield. Later absorption neither changes the attacker nor extends the opportunity. Ordinary hits and other abilities cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.16.label: Shared Vigil
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.16.descriptio: Within 3 seconds after the partner’s Joined Voices shield first absorbs enemy damage, walk at least one cell closer to that partner and ordinarily hit an enemy while within 2 cells for a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds, once. Teleporting cancels it. Later hits neither refill nor extend the shield; an absent original partner is never replaced. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.17.label: Pursuit after Passage
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.17.descriptio: While the Return Passage shield remains active, its original patient can land an ordinary hit on the enemy that triggered it to deal 50 extra soul damage. Once per passage, attributed to the shield author; no other ally or the author can claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.18.label: The Way Home
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Spirit.nodes.18.descriptio: Within 3 seconds after the passage shield first absorbs enemy damage, walk at least one cell closer to its original patient, then ordinarily hit a different enemy while within 2 cells to mend up to 20 points of their non-permanent injury. Once per shield. Teleporting cancels it; no eligible wound retains the opportunity without extending it. Scars are excluded. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
